question:
Read the following passage and answer the question that follows. Some words have been replaced by blanks numbered (1) to (5).

Passage:
Ravi's small shop seemed destined to ____(1)____ when a larger competitor opened a store across the street. Many friends advised him to sell out, but he refused to throw in the ____(2)____. Instead, he decided to ____(3)____ with a new range of products that his rival did not stock, and he strictly adhered ____(4)____ his policy of fair prices. Hardly had the festive season begun ____(5)____ customers started pouring in, and by the end of the year his shop was more profitable than ever.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
explanation: 'founder' (verb) = असफल होना/डूब जाना; संदर्भ: बड़ा प्रतिद्वंद्वी आने से दुकान का चलना मुश्किल दिखा। flourish, prevail और thrive का अर्थ फलना-फूलना है (विपरीत)। Example: The project foundered due to lack of funds.
